# MockTestVault — Zero-Distraction CBT Mock Exam Simulator

> MockTestVault (https://mocktestvault.com) is a high-speed, zero-distraction computer-based test (CBT) simulator for national and international standardized examinations. 100% free, 100% client-side, zero user login requirements, zero advertisements, and zero remote telemetry.

## Core Educational Principles
- **Authentic Examination Interfaces:** Accurately mimics official computer-based testing engines (TCS iON for SSC CGL, College Board Bluebook for Digital SAT, and standard CBSE Board Exam pattern).
- **Zero Distraction & Absolute Privacy:** No advertising banners, no sponsored links, no mandatory registration, and zero trackers. All test history and scores are persisted strictly inside the student's local browser via LocalStorage.
- **Deep Explanations & Rationales:** Every single multiple-choice question contains verified step-by-step mathematical derivations, historical context, chemical mechanisms, or grammatical rules.

## CBSE Class 10 Board Exam Vault (/cbse-class-10/)
Complete syllabus coverage matching the latest 2025-2026 NCERT curriculum and CBSE assessment guidelines across 48 chapters and full board mock papers.

### Mathematics Chapters
- [Real Numbers](https://mocktestvault.com/cbse-class-10/mathematics/ch01_real_numbers.html): Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic, irrationality proofs, and HCF/LCM applications.
- [Polynomials](https://mocktestvault.com/cbse-class-10/mathematics/ch02_polynomials.html): Geometrical meaning of zeroes, relationship between coefficients and zeroes of quadratic polynomials.
- [Linear Equations in Two Variables](https://mocktestvault.com/cbse-class-10/mathematics/ch03_linear_equations_two_variables.html): Graphical and algebraic solution methods (substitution, elimination), consistency conditions.
- [Quadratic Equations](https://mocktestvault.com/cbse-class-10/mathematics/ch04_quadratic_equations.html): Standard form, factorization, quadratic formula, discriminant and nature of roots.
- [Arithmetic Progressions](https://mocktestvault.com/cbse-class-10/mathematics/ch05_arithmetic_progressions.html): nth term derivation, sum of first n terms, and daily life application problems.
- [Triangles](https://mocktestvault.com/cbse-class-10/mathematics/ch06_triangles.html): Basic Proportionality Theorem (Thales), criteria for similarity of triangles (AAA, SSS, SAS).
- [Coordinate Geometry](https://mocktestvault.com/cbse-class-10/mathematics/ch07_coordinate_geometry.html): Distance formula, section formula (internal division), and midpoint applications.
- [Introduction to Trigonometry](https://mocktestvault.com/cbse-class-10/mathematics/ch08_introduction_to_trigonometry.html): Trigonometric ratios of acute angles, standard values (0°, 30°, 45°, 60°, 90°), and trigonometric identities.
- [Some Applications of Trigonometry](https://mocktestvault.com/cbse-class-10/mathematics/ch09_some_applications_of_trigonometry.html): Heights and distances, angles of elevation and depression with single and double right-triangle problems.
- [Circles](https://mocktestvault.com/cbse-class-10/mathematics/ch10_circles.html): Tangent at any point of a circle, tangents drawn from an external point theorem.
- [Areas Related to Circles](https://mocktestvault.com/cbse-class-10/mathematics/ch11_areas_related_to_circles.html): Areas of sectors and segments of a circle, arc lengths, and combination figures.
- [Surface Areas and Volumes](https://mocktestvault.com/cbse-class-10/mathematics/ch12_surface_areas_volumes.html): Surface areas and volumes of combinations of cubes, cuboids, spheres, hemispheres, and right circular cylinders/cones.
- [Statistics](https://mocktestvault.com/cbse-class-10/mathematics/ch13_statistics.html): Mean (direct, assumed mean methods), median, and mode of grouped data, empirical relationship between measures of central tendency.
- [Probability](https://mocktestvault.com/cbse-class-10/mathematics/ch14_probability.html): Classical definition of probability, simple problems on finding probability of an event.
- [Mathematics Master Formula Sheet](https://mocktestvault.com/cbse-class-10/math-formulas.html): Complete chapterwise formula reference, theorems, and identities for rapid board exam revision.

### Science Chapters
- [Chemical Reactions and Equations](https://mocktestvault.com/cbse-class-10/science/ch01_chemical_reactions.html): Balanced chemical equations, combination, decomposition, displacement, double displacement, oxidation and reduction.
- [Acids, Bases and Salts](https://mocktestvault.com/cbse-class-10/science/ch02_acids_bases_salts.html): Chemical properties, neutralization, pH scale, preparation and uses of Bleaching Powder, Baking Soda, Washing Soda, Plaster of Paris.
- [Metals and Non-Metals](https://mocktestvault.com/cbse-class-10/science/ch03_metals_non_metals.html): Physical and chemical properties, reactivity series, formation and properties of ionic compounds, metallurgy, corrosion prevention.
- [Carbon and Its Compounds](https://mocktestvault.com/cbse-class-10/science/ch04_carbon_compounds.html): Covalent bonding, versatile nature of carbon, homologous series, IUPAC nomenclature, combustion, oxidation, addition, substitution, soaps and detergents.
- [Life Processes](https://mocktestvault.com/cbse-class-10/science/ch05_life_processes.html): Autotrophic/heterotrophic nutrition, cellular respiration, human circulatory system, plant transport, human excretory system.
- [Control and Coordination](https://mocktestvault.com/cbse-class-10/science/ch06_control_coordination.html): Nervous system in animals, reflex arcs, brain anatomy, plant hormones (auxins, gibberellins, cytokinins, abscisic acid), endocrine system.
- [How Do Organisms Reproduce?](https://mocktestvault.com/cbse-class-10/science/ch07_how_organisms_reproduce.html): Asexual reproduction modes, sexual reproduction in flowering plants, human male and female reproductive systems, reproductive health.
- [Heredity](https://mocktestvault.com/cbse-class-10/science/ch08_heredity.html): Mendel's laws of inheritance, monohybrid and dihybrid crosses, sex determination in human beings.
- [Light – Reflection and Refraction](https://mocktestvault.com/cbse-class-10/science/ch09_light_reflection_refraction.html): Mirror formula, magnification, Snell's law, refractive index, lens formula, power of a lens, ray diagrams.
- [The Human Eye and the Colourful World](https://mocktestvault.com/cbse-class-10/science/ch10_human_eye_colourful_world.html): Refraction through a prism, dispersion, atmospheric refraction (twinkling of stars), scattering of light (Tyndall effect).
- [Electricity](https://mocktestvault.com/cbse-class-10/science/ch11_electricity.html): Ohm's law, resistance, resistivity, series and parallel resistor combinations, Joule's heating effect, electric power.
- [Magnetic Effects of Electric Current](https://mocktestvault.com/cbse-class-10/science/ch12_magnetic_effects_electric_current.html): Magnetic field lines, Right-Hand Thumb Rule, Fleming's Left-Hand Rule, electromagnetic induction, domestic electric circuits.
- [Our Environment](https://mocktestvault.com/cbse-class-10/science/ch13_our_environment.html): Ecosystem components, food chains and webs, 10% energy transfer law, biological magnification, ozone layer depletion.

### Social Science Chapters
- [The Rise of Nationalism in Europe](https://mocktestvault.com/cbse-class-10/social-science/ch01_rise_of_nationalism_europe.html): French Revolution, Napoleonic Code, unification of Italy and Germany, visualising the nation, imperialism.
- [Nationalism in India](https://mocktestvault.com/cbse-class-10/social-science/ch02_nationalism_in_india.html): First World War impact, Rowlatt Act, Jallianwala Bagh, Non-Cooperation Movement, Civil Disobedience Movement, Salt March, sense of collective belonging.
- [The Making of a Global World](https://mocktestvault.com/cbse-class-10/social-science/ch03_making_of_a_global_world.html): Silk routes, conquest, disease, trade, 19th-century global economy, Great Depression, post-war Bretton Woods institutions.
- [The Age of Industrialisation](https://mocktestvault.com/cbse-class-10/social-science/ch04_age_of_industrialisation.html): Proto-industrialisation, factories emergence, hand labour vs steam power, industrialisation in colonies, market for goods.
- [Print Culture and the Modern World](https://mocktestvault.com/cbse-class-10/social-science/ch05_print_culture_modern_world.html): Development of print in East Asia and Europe, Gutenberg press, print revolution, reading mania, print and the French Revolution, 19th-century Indian print.
- [Resources and Development](https://mocktestvault.com/cbse-class-10/social-science/ch06_resources_and_development.html): Types of resources, sustainable development, Rio Summit, Agenda 21, land degradation and conservation measures, soil classification of India.
- [Forest and Wildlife Resources](https://mocktestvault.com/cbse-class-10/social-science/ch07_forest_and_wildlife_resources.html): Biodiversity in India, IUCN species classification, conservation projects (Project Tiger), sacred groves, Joint Forest Management.
- [Water Resources](https://mocktestvault.com/cbse-class-10/social-science/ch08_water_resources.html): Water scarcity, multi-purpose river projects and their ecological impact, rainwater harvesting systems in India.
- [Agriculture](https://mocktestvault.com/cbse-class-10/social-science/ch09_agriculture.html): Types of farming (primitive, intensive subsistence, commercial), cropping seasons (Rabi, Kharif, Zaid), major crops, technological and institutional reforms.
- [Minerals and Energy Resources](https://mocktestvault.com/cbse-class-10/social-science/ch10_minerals_and_energy_resources.html): Mode of occurrence of minerals, ferrous and non-ferrous, non-metallic, conventional and non-conventional energy sources.
- [Manufacturing Industries](https://mocktestvault.com/cbse-class-10/social-science/ch11_manufacturing_industries.html): Importance of manufacturing, industrial location, agro-based and mineral-based industries, industrial pollution and environmental degradation.
- [Lifelines of National Economy](https://mocktestvault.com/cbse-class-10/social-science/ch12_lifelines_of_national_economy.html): Roadways, golden quadrilateral, railways, pipelines, waterways, major ports, airways, communication networks, international trade, tourism.
- [Power Sharing](https://mocktestvault.com/cbse-class-10/social-science/ch13_power_sharing.html): Case studies of Belgium and Sri Lanka, majoritarianism, accommodation, necessity of power sharing, horizontal and vertical power sharing.
- [Federalism](https://mocktestvault.com/cbse-class-10/social-science/ch14_federalism.html): Key features of federalism, coming together vs holding together federations, legislative lists (Union, State, Concurrent), decentralisation and the 1992 constitutional amendments.
- [Gender, Religion and Caste](https://mocktestvault.com/cbse-class-10/social-science/ch15_gender_religion_caste.html): Sexual division of labour, feminist movements, women's political representation, communalism and secular state, caste inequalities and caste in politics.
- [Political Parties](https://mocktestvault.com/cbse-class-10/social-science/ch16_political_parties.html): Functions and necessity of political parties, party systems (one-party, two-party, multi-party), national and regional parties of India, challenges and reform measures.
- [Outcomes of Democracy](https://mocktestvault.com/cbse-class-10/social-science/ch17_outcomes_of_democracy.html): Accountable, responsive, and legitimate government, economic growth and development, reduction of inequality and poverty, accommodation of social diversity.
- [Development](https://mocktestvault.com/cbse-class-10/social-science/ch18_development.html): Different people, different goals, national development, per capita income, World Bank criteria, Human Development Index (HDI), sustainability of development.
- [Sectors of the Indian Economy](https://mocktestvault.com/cbse-class-10/social-science/ch19_sectors_of_indian_economy.html): Primary, secondary, and tertiary sectors, historical change in sectors, rising importance of tertiary sector, disguised unemployment, MGNREGA 2005.
- [Money and Credit](https://mocktestvault.com/cbse-class-10/social-science/ch20_money_and_credit.html): Barter system and double coincidence of wants, modern forms of money, loan activities of banks, terms of credit, formal vs informal credit sector in India, Self-Help Groups (SHGs).
- [Globalisation and the Indian Economy](https://mocktestvault.com/cbse-class-10/social-science/ch21_globalisation_and_indian_economy.html): Multinational corporations (MNCs), foreign trade and integration of markets, factors enabling globalisation (technology, trade liberalisation, WTO), impact on India, struggle for fair globalisation.
